2609.16213.title: Artificial intelligence and biosecurity: capabilities, threat pathways, and defense-in-depth governance
2609.16213.paper_summary: Artificial intelligence is reshaping biological research across an increasingly connected digital-to-physical workflow. General-purpose large language models can retrieve and integrate scientific information, support experimental planning, and computational analysis; biological foundation models can predict, optimize, and generate proteins, genes, and genome-scale sequences; agentic systems can coordinate multistep research tasks; automated laboratories can partially close the design-build-test-learn cycle. These technologies could greatly benefit medicine, public health, and biotechnology. However, their biosecurity risk depends not only on what the AI can do, but also on who uses it, their expertise and intent, their access to laboratory tools and materials, and the safeguards in place. Current evidence shows that AI uplift exists but primarily affects digital rather than physical tasks. Frontier systems have exceeded expert baselines on in-silico, and screening-evasion benchmarks, whereas controlled wet-laboratory studies find that tacit knowledge and physical execution remain substantial barriers. This review describes the different biological threats from AI tool use, from information gathering and biological design to procurement, synthesis, testing, scale-up, and potential release. We further examine why alignment techniques for general-purpose models transfer poorly to biological ones, and the emerging role of interpretability in auditing whether hazardous capabilities are genuinely removed. We argue for defense-in-depth governance that links capability thresholds to proportionate responsibilities across the biological AI ecosystem, reducing high-consequence risk while preserving beneficial use.
2609.16213.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧正在重塑生物研究，跨越越來越互聯的數位到實體工作流程。通用的大型語言模型可以檢索和整合科學資訊，支持實驗規劃和計算分析；生物基礎模型可以預測、優化和生成蛋白質、基因及基因組規模的序列；代理系統可以協調多步驟的研究任務；自動化實驗室可以部分關閉設計-建造-測試-學習的循環。這些技術可能對醫學、公共衛生和生物技術帶來巨大的好處。然而，它們的生物安全風險不僅取決於人工智慧能做什麼，還取決於誰在使用它、他們的專業知識和意圖、他們對實驗室工具和材料的獲取，以及現有的保障措施。當前的證據顯示，人工智慧的提升存在，但主要影響數位而非實體任務。前沿系統在計算機模擬和篩選逃避基準上超越了專家基準，而受控的濕實驗室研究發現，隱性知識和實體執行仍然是重大障礙。這篇評論描述了使用人工智慧工具所帶來的不同生物威脅，從資訊收集和生物設計到採購、合成、測試、放大和潛在釋放。我們進一步探討為什麼通用模型的對齊技術對生物模型的轉移效果不佳，以及可解釋性在審核危險能力是否真正被移除中的新興角色。我們主張採取深度防禦治理，將能力閾值與生物人工智慧生態系統中的相應責任聯繫起來，減少高後果風險，同時保留有益的使用。
